derivation: of Chaldee origin (compare H01660 and H08081);
def: oil-press; Gethsemane, a garden near Jerusalem

occurrences.text: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
